premises.text: Professionals often forget to bill calls made on their mobile phones, leading to significant financial losses.
premises.evidence_span: over time, this adds up into huge losses

premises.text: A significant portion of billable time spent on mobile calls goes unbilled.
premises.evidence_span: roughly 40% of the time professionals that bill by the hour spend talking on a mobile phone goes unbilled

premises.text: A mobile app can automate the billing process for calls.
premises.evidence_span: our app automatically starts tracking that call for billing

premises.text: The app can increase the number of billable hours for professionals.
premises.evidence_span: one 15-minute missed call a day equals 20,000 a year

value.text: Professionals can recover lost revenue by accurately billing for mobile calls.
value.evidence_span: one 15-minute missed call a day equals 20,000 a year

notes: Download and user metrics excluded as traction.
